positions.title: Full-Stack Mobile Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop cross-platform React Native applications for an IoT boating ecosystem, enabling recreational boaters and OEM customers to monitor and interact with connected onboard systems, view boat and engine data, record trips, and manage service information.

• Spearheaded development of Argon, a reusable React Native design system designed to standardize UI across 8+ OEM boating applications, with 20+ core components, 700+ design tokens, composable variants, OEM-specific theming, and Storybook integration.
• Architected Argon around reusable component primitives and OEM-specific configurations, allowing a shared codebase to support different brand identities while improving UI consistency and maintainability.
• Built a custom Figma-to-code design-token pipeline that generates tokens.json, automating synchronization of OEM colors, typography, icons, sizing, and spacing and reducing updates from a manual process to typically under 30 minutes.
• Led the incremental migration from the legacy design system, coordinating development with engineering and UI/UX while maintaining production stability and validating changes across physical devices.
• Led a React Native 0.72 → 0.77 upgrade to meet App Store requirements, resolving Firestore and dependency compatibility issues and updating iOS and Android configurations.
• Automated Argon release workflows using GitHub Actions, including release-note generation, package publishing, and versioning.
• Conduct regular code reviews and provide guidance on architecture, maintainability, performance, React Native patterns, and coding standards while collaborating with team members.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Cloud Firestore · Firebase · Front-End Design · GitHub

positions.title: Associate Engineer - WERLD Rotation 3: Machine Learning
positions.locationName: Benton Harbor, Michigan, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Analyzed AWS Redshift datasets and trained lightweight machine learning models to enhance dryers' drying performance and energy efficiency.
- Designed and developed a proof-of-concept Android app feature using image classification to analyze captured images of stains, identify their type, and provide users with effective removal techniques.
- Streamlined semi-automated dryer performance model training, testing, and creation pipeline on AWS SageMaker Pipelines for efficient experiment monitoring.

positions.title: Associate Engineer - WERLD Rotation 2: Model Based Design
positions.locationName: Benton Harbor, Michigan, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Increased potential development and testing efficiency by developing a virtualized process for optimizing cooking appliance plant models, reducing dependence on physical testing, and minimizing unoptimized parameters.
- Applied data visualization and exploratory techniques to optimize feature selection for a neural network predicting dryer machines' load characteristics.

positions.title: Associate Engineer - WERLD Rotation 1: Cooking Performance
positions.locationName: Benton Harbor, Michigan, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Evaluated product accessory performance to define performance integration gaps, improving integration between two product lines.
- Supported implementation of simulation and controls, accelerating the implementation of tools into the team and reducing future product development time.
- Trained team members on technical Minitab software capabilities, improving D2D processes.
